mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and metabolized by CYP450 enzymes; disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing albendazole metabolite accumulation and hepatic injury risk.
action: Monitor liver function tests before and during concurrent use; consider alternative anthelmintic if hepatic impairment present; counsel patient on alcohol avoidance (disulfiram requirement) and hepatotoxicity signs.
